lastCompletedStory.title: Prove steady state, keep the allowlist at one entry, and record the mechanism in patterns.md

nextStoryContext: US-006 closes CAM-510 (this branch's final story). No production or test files were touched: US-001..US-005 already own the five fixed-parent-tmpdir sites and their five regression tests (test/release/ship-pr-tempfile.test.ts, test/vendor/embedded-cache-bounded.test.ts, test/supervisor/task-prompt-root-bounded.test.ts, test/supervisor/codex-instructions-reap.test.ts, test/setup-config-log.test.ts), all of which already existed on this branch at US-006's start. This story only ran proofs and wrote one durable patterns.md bullet. AC11 (allowlist invariant) and AC13 (fixation guard) were already green at dispatch start, verified by re-running both oracles literally: scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts's test-path entry count is 1 on this branch, matching the count re-derived live from main (git show main:scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts), and none of the five new test files appears in the allowlist (all five root their tmpdir redirection at the repo-local createTestTmpdir() scratch helper, never node:os's tmpdir() directly, per GOTCHA 14/CAM-508's allowlist convention) -- `bun scripts/check-test-tmpdir.ts` exits 0. AC13's two 20_000 budgets in test/vendor/check-agent-frontmatter-standalone.test.ts were untouched, 2 = 2 against main. AC12 (the loop-closing steady-state proof) was executed literally per the oracle body: warm-up `bun test` run (6091 pass / 0 fail, 85.80s) left the combined ^cam- top-level entry count (summed across $TMPDIR and /tmp) at 108806, then a second immediate `bun test` run (6091 pass / 0 fail, 83.33s) left the count at 108806 again -- delta 0, proving the fixed-parent consolidation from US-001..US-005 has reached steady state (the five sites create their fixed top-level parents once; subsequent runs only nest pid/version-keyed children underneath, which don't add new top-level entries). AC14 (durable record) is a new patterns.md bullet with the literal attribution `(US-006, CAM-503, 2026-08-06)` (matching the oracle's required regex) documenting both the measurement procedure (warm-up-then-diff, never a single before/after snapshot) and the actual measured numbers, appended after the existing CAM-508 allowlist-gate bullet at the end of the file. All gates verified green this dispatch: typecheck clean (bunx tsc --noEmit, 3.9s), full bun test 6091 pass / 0 fail (370 files, matches the documented count from US-005's handoff), full bun run check:all spine green (typecheck/test/embed-vendor/lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/test-tmpdir/skip-ratchet all ok, exit 0). No vendor/templates changes, so embed-vendor:check was exercised only as part of check:all (already-clean, no regeneration needed). This closes CAM-510's full scope: all five production sites are fixed, all five regression tests exist and pass, the allowlist gate holds at exactly its one inherited entry, and the steady-state proof is durably recorded. If the PRD has no further stories, the next dispatch should find PRD_COMPLETE.
